note: Transcribed from Hongjiacheng's own datasheets as served by LCSC (no manufacturer-hosted copy was located; LIBRARY.md section 2 fallback, as for BZT52C5V6). Values are the electrical-characteristics tables as printed; the PDFs are not committed.

package.source: every sheet's last page, 'Package Outline Dimensions' and 'Suggested Pad Layout', is the same table as the BZT52C sheet the land was drawn from (A 3.55-3.85, B 2.55-2.85, C 1.40-1.80, D 0.95-1.35, J 0.91 min, K 2.36 max, M 1.22 min); the MM1Z sheet labels that page '(SOT-23)' while its ordering table and page 1 say SOD-123

polarity: page 1 of every sheet: 'Polarity: Cathode line denotes the cathode end'; the outline drawing puts the cathode band on the left in top view, which is pad 1 at -x on the land
